::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
library(tidyverse)
df_url="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jmayberr/math133-stat-learning-fall2026/refs/heads/main/Datasets/Beerwings.csv"
beerwings=read.csv(df_url) |>
  select(-ID)
head(beerwings)
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
  Hotwings Beer Gender
1        4   24      F
2        5    0      F
3        5   12      F
4        6   12      F
5        7   12      F
6        7   12      F
```


:::
:::


Model for Beer \~ Hotwings


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
beer_lm=lm(Beer~Hotwings,data=beerwings)
```
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
wings12=which(beerwings$Hotwings==12)
pred_values=predict(beer_lm,interval="confidence")
pred_values[wings12,]
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
        fit      lwr      upr
14 26.32938 23.53193 29.12684
15 26.32938 23.53193 29.12684
```


:::
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
new_df=data.frame(Hotwings=12)
predict(beer_lm,new_df,interval="confidence")
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
       fit      lwr      upr
1 26.32938 23.53193 29.12684
```


:::
:::


Gender Plot


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
beerwings |>
  ggplot(aes(x=Gender,y=Beer,fill=Gender))+
  stat_boxplot(geom="errorbar",width=0.2)+
  geom_boxplot(width=0.5)+
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("cyan","deeppink"))
```

::: {.cell-output-display}

Including Gender in Model


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
beer_lm2=lm(Beer~Gender,data=beerwings)
summary(beer_lm2)
```
